lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᏣᏉᎯᏳᎭ, ᏥᎦᏔᎭ ᎠᏆᎴᏂᏓᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᏂᏥᎥ ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏓᏍᏗᏱ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᏁᏉᏤᏗᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒᎢ.
lines.english: And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;
lines.emitted_text: nahskino hi'a tsinuhsti tsakwohiyuha tsikathaha akwalenitahstiyi ale nitsi'v itsvyelatitahstiyi nahski itsinehkwotsehtiyi ale itsalihelihstiyi itsohiyuhsv'i

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᏁᏉᏨᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎬ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎠᏴ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏫᏨᎷᏤᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
lines.english: That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again.
lines.emitted_text: nahski utsathi unhekwotsvhstiyi itsalhelikv tsihsa kalonetv iywanihsatv ayv nvtikalhstohtihskv nahski thaline witsvlutsehti kehsv iyuhsti

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏗᎾ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏧᎵᎶᎲᏍᎦ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎵᏙᎮᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏫᏨᎷᏤᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏱᏫᏨᎪᎥ, ᎠᎴ ᏯᎩᎪᏁᎸᏉ, ᏱᎦᏛᎬᎦ ᏂᏣᏛᎿᎭᏕᎬᎢ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏕᏥᏙᎬ ᏌᏉ ᎠᏓᏅᏙᎩᎯ, ᏌᏉ ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏗ ᎬᏗ, ᎠᏖᏆᎶᎯ ᎢᏣᏟᏂᎬᏁᏗᏱ ᎢᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ.
lines.english: Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;
lines.emitted_text: nahskiya atina kalonetv utseli ohstv khanohetv tsulilohvhska nitsatvnelitohehsti nahski iyuhnho yiwitsvluhtselv ale ywitsvko'v ale yakkhonelkwo yikathvkvka nitsatvnhatekv'i ulhinikitv tetsitokv hsakwo atantokihi hsakwo atanvhthehti kvhti athehkwalohi itsalhinikvnehtiyi itsihstelhvhtiy kohiythi khsv ohst khanhetv

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎠᎴ ᏞᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏛᏁᎲ ᎨᏣᏡᏗᏍᎩ ᏱᏥᏍᎦᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ; ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᎯ ᎨᏥᏛᏙᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏁᎯ ᎡᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
lines.english: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God.
lines.emitted_text: ale lhsti khuhsti antvnhv ketsaluthski ytsihskahstanhehsti nahsk kvnhikhsv iyunnehi ktsttti khsv'i nhihskin kvnikhsv itsvnhi etsihstelti kehs'i ale nhski uhnelanvhi itshstelvti khsv'i

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᏂᎯᏰᏃ ᎡᏥᏁᎸᎯ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝ ᎡᏦᎢᏳᏗᏱᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᏥᎩᎵᏤᏗᏱ;
lines.english: For unto you it is given in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏗᏒᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏴ ᏥᏍᎩᎪᎡᎸᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯ ᏥᏣᏛᎩᎭ ᎠᏇᎲᎢ.
lines.english: Having the same conflict which ye saw in me, and now hear to be in me.
